newsitem.title: CROATIA: Volume up, rates flat at Croatian cenbank auction.
newsitem.headline: Volume up, rates flat at Croatian cenbank auction.

text.p: Bill volume rose to 281 million kuna at Croatia's central bank auction on Wednesday from last week's 197 million as commercial banks reinvested part of the money they were repaid from a previous maturity, the bank said.
"We had expiry of 406 million kuna (deals) and some of these funds back. But liquidity is still thin," an official told Reuters.
The 35- and 91-day rates were flat at 7.50 and 9.0 percent, respectively.
The bank said it might intervene to help banking sector liquidity later in the week through a sale of foreign exchange, probably due for repurchase early next week.
